brief.zh: 从第 11 拍（从 0 数起）开始一直回答「是」，在那之前回答「否」。
brief.en: Answer yes from tick 11 on (counting from 0), and no before it.

t.zh: 探针刚插上时不知道总线正说到哪里，要先等一阵。等多久是一个定好的数，板上还没有能写下一个数的元件。
t.en: A probe just plugged in does not know where the bus is in what it is saying, so it waits a while first. How long is a fixed number, and the board has no part yet that holds a number.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>：总是给出它设的那个数。
t.en: A new part, <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>: always gives the number it is set to.

after.zh: 计数加上一个比较，就是"等到第几拍"。
after.en: A count and a comparison make “wait until tick so-and-so”.
